title: When converting a fuel-gas furnace to natural gas, are oxygen analysers and CO alarms supplied separately?
summary: Suneng's 2018 retrofit recommendation for a bearing-steel wire spheroidising annealing furnace proposes replacing coal-derived cooled fuel gas with natural gas and modifying combustion-ratio control. Two oxygen analysers are optional, each shared by two temperature-control zones. Two separate audible/visual carbon-monoxide alarms are buyer-supplied for key locations around the valve station and furnace area. Their duties and supply boundaries must be checked separately.
